entries.title: A pull request's checks no longer read as passed before GitHub starts them
entries.body: When a check a crewmate started by hand had already passed, the app could read a new pull request's checks as passed in the moment before GitHub started the pull request's own checks, so a merge card could reach you too early. The app now reads them as running until GitHub has started them.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen; the checks read as running a little longer, until GitHub starts the pull request's own checks.
